messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — SI launch announcement landed on the calendar for next Thursday. Need final decisions on QBR scorecard inputs, MDF split, and marketplace promo credits. Who can triage?
Mike: I can take MDF split. Can we reuse last quarter's slab or should we rejigger for the co-sell motion?
Jordan: Marketplace promo credits need to be separate from MDF — listing credits are tracked differently. I'll map the SKU-level promos.
Olivia: FYI finance prefers a 60/30/10 split (redwood/si/marketplace) as a starting point for pilot. We should validate with expected uplift numbers.
Ana: Cool. @Mike can you run a quick calc against the Q3 pipeline? Even a 2-slide summary is fine for the exec QBR.
Mike: On it. Will run two scenarios (conservative / stretch). ETA 3pm today.
Sam: From the SI side — we need co-marketing budget for a joint webinar + localized enablement (~$8k). Also want a joint playbook item in the partner portal.
Jordan: Noted. I'll draft the marketplace banner copy and a small promo plan. Can we reserve a temporary marketplace spotlight for launch week?
Ana: Yes, request it. @Jordan can you open the request ticket and tag product ops?
Jordan: Done — ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MP-4310 — tagged @product-ops.
Olivia: Re MDF: if webinar + enablement is $8k, that should come out of the SI portion. We still need to set guardrails: approved activities, invoice templates, and a 30-day claim window.
Mike: I'll draft the claim template. Question: do we want performance clawbacks if the partner doesn't hit the lead-to-opportunity threshold?
Sam: We can't sign partner contracts with heavy clawbacks for the SI — they'll push back. Suggest incentives tied to outcomes instead (e.g., additional co-funds unlocked at 50 opportunities).
Ana: Good point. Let's do milestone-based unlocks rather than clawbacks. @Olivia please add milestone schedule to finance doc.
Olivia: Will add. Also attaching a tiny table in the draft: 
```
Scenario | Redwood | SI | Marketplace
Conservative | 60% | 30% | 10%
Stretch | 50% | 35% | 15%
```
Mike: That helps. I'll overlay expected ARR by scenario.
Jordan: For the QBR scorecard — propose these KPIs: marketplace installs, co-sell pipeline ($), webinar registrants, SI enablement completions. Short list so ops can track easily.
Ana: Agree. Keep it to 4-5 metrics. We should also capture qualitative readiness for joint announcements (press kit, legal sign-off).
Sam: Legal has one ask: we need pre-approved messaging bullets and a single point of contact for embargo coordination. I'll loop legal if we finalize bullets today.
Ana: Who volunteers to own the announcement bullets? @Jordan? @Mike?
Mike: I can draft the bullets and share for quick sign-off.
Jordan: I'll add marketplace-specific lines.
Nora-bot: Reminder: QBR materials deadline in 4 days. Upload to /shared/partners/qbrs/next-launch by EOD Wednesday.
Olivia: Noted. Also flagging that FY budget closes on Friday — any spend that needs a PO must be submitted by tomorrow.
Sam: We'll submit the webinar PO today.
Mike: Draft MDF split doc uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1XY-mdf-pilot-split — please review, comments welcome.
Ana: Thanks @Mike. Action items recap: (1) Mike: finalize MDF scenarios + upload by 3pm. (2) Jordan: open marketplace spotlight ticket (done) + draft banner copy. (3) Olivia: add milestone schedule + invoice template. (4) Sam: submit webinar PO + coordinate legal. (5) Ana: consolidate scorecard and announce bullets.
Jordan: Quick ops question — do we want a dedicated Slack channel for announcement-day triage?
Ana: Yes, create #launch-si-marketplace-nextweek and invite stakeholders + oncall.
Jordan: Created and invited everyone.
Olivia: One more finance note — if we pay any part upfront, ops needs a signed SOW from the SI. Sam, can you push that?
Sam: Will follow up with contracts this afternoon.
Mike: Updated the MDF calc with ARR overlays: shared in the doc, left three comments for assumptions.
Ana: Great momentum. Let's sync one more time tomorrow morning for a 15m pre-check before the QBR deck freeze.
Sam: 15m works. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
